question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'that'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence ' **It is only by physiological research (5)______ medicine has been able to advance **' requires an appropriate word from the given options to be filled in the blank number 5.
 
• Marked option** 'that'** is used for introducing a clause stating a fact.
 
• In the above sentence **'that'** will be used in the given blank as it states the fact why medicine has been able to advance.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**
